SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sa.id_student)
FROM studentAssessment sa
JOIN assessments a ON sa.id_assessment = a.id_assessment
WHERE a.code_module = 'BBB' 
  AND a.code_presentation = '2013J' 
  AND a.assessment_type = 'TMA'
GROUP BY sa.id_student
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.id_assessment) = (
    SELECT COUNT(*) 
    FROM assessments 
    WHERE code_module = 'BBB' 
      AND code_presentation = '2013J' 
      AND assessment_type = 'TMA'
);
